description: Answer a metalworking engineering or sourcing question from Balford's own published engineering material. Covers fine blanking and thinning / ironing deep drawing as focus processes, plus progressive and transfer dies, precision stamping, sheet metal, CNC, brazing, annealing, plating, tolerances, DFM and RFQ preparation. Returns a written answer with numbered citations plus the source pages. Use this for 'how do I', 'what is', 'which process fits', or 'what do you need for an RFQ' questions. It will not quote a price, a lead-time guarantee, a certification Balford does not hold, or anything from a customer drawing. Answers are assembled from Balford's own published engineering material and cite the page each claim came from. Nothing is quoted that is not already public on balford.net. This is not a quotation, a certification claim, or a dimensional acceptance.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag for the question, for the review log. Defaults to 'en'.

question.description: The engineering or sourcing question, in plain language. Max 600 characters.

name: ask_balford_engineering

guard_violations.description: Claims the code-level boundary removed before the answer was returned.

mode.description: 'rag' when a language model wrote the answer from retrieved passages; 'retrieval' when the model was unavailable or the budget was spent, and the answer is quoted extractively from the strongest passage.

next.description: The practical next step Balford recommends.

quality.description: How well Balford's published material covers the question: strong, thin, or none.

sources.description: The published balford.net pages the answer was retrieved from, in citation order.

excerpt.description: The passage text that was retrieved, truncated.

n.description: Citation marker used in the answer text as [[n]].

url.description: Canonical URL of the cited page.

title: Ask Balford's engineering assistant
